title: Baseline
summary: A written record of the platform as it is today (services, routes, Kafka events, pre-SDD work and known gaps) so later features are checked against a known starting point.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Lists all 10 runnable packages plus shared, each with port, owned data store and responsibility.
Every gateway route listed with method, path, owning service and auth requirement; service-only routes marked internal.
Each of the 6 Kafka topics listed with producer, consumers and actual payload; producer/consumer mismatches listed as gaps.
Records pre-SDD work: frontend pages, assistant tools and its 2 providers, internal service token behaviour.
Known-gaps list includes the 5 known gaps and every gap points to a roadmap feature or backlog item.
After a clean docker compose up, every backend /health is healthy and the frontend GET / returns 200; result recorded as a measurement.
npm run check and npm run build pass; no file under packages/ changed.

tasks.title: Create baseline.md skeleton with header and Source lines

Known gaps table; route new gaps to the roadmap

Tick ACs, update roadmap and memory

openQuestions.text: Where does the baseline live? Proposed: baseline.md in this folder, linked from architecture.md.
Keep AC-6 (stack health via Docker) given no live model yet? Proposed: yes, health checks only.
List frontend page routes too? Proposed: yes, as a short separate table.
New gaps found: backlog or new Phase 0 feature? Proposed: backlog, unless cross-user data access.
